note: RI-QST09 §1 asks what a resolution CLOSES, and grades it K1 (another resolution of the same quest) / K2 (another quest) / K3 (a faction line) / K4 (a service the world loses: a merchant, a trainer, a transport line, a shrine, a settlement's safety). The quest files declare world flags; this file says what each of those flags takes away. It is separate from the quest data on purpose — RI-QST04 'How we lose' requires behaviour hooks to live in a systems layer keyed by world_flags rather than inside the quest — and it is what makes the closure graph computable by tools/analysis/quest-audit.mjs without running the game.

gated.what: Archon's only cure-potion vendor. The coast has no other.
The dye trade: a merchant, a price row, and the reason Archon has a harbour.
Every lichen-blind beggar on the coast stops speaking to the player. A rumour layer, gone.
The harvester families who guide across the lichen beds at low water.
The sap-house on the eastern track: a fence, a trainer in root-speech, and three cutters.
The Helstrom-to-Archon phial run. A transport line and the income on it.
The eastern root track out of Helstrom. The short way in becomes the long way round.
The timber gang: the yard's labour, and the only source of cut thornwood in Blackwood.
The Gideon quay stops being walkable at night for an outlander. A settlement's safety.
Sedd's stores gate: the Legion quartermaster who sells to civilians.
The Wren's Soulrest-to-Gideon run. One of three ways up the coast without walking.
The Sap-Cutters close entirely.
The Drowned Court's ranks above 2.
The rootkeepers under the old temple.
The garrison's patronage line.
The Assize's Lilmoth file, and with it the Assize's southern line.
The hollow's cutters as a faction the player can work with.
The harvesters' own questline.
The lease-abolition line.
The company's own approach to the player.
The unwritten eleven's line.
Ossei's account of the Flu years.

reopenable.price: 1200 gold paid to the sap-house and a phial run made at no fee. Once, and only from rank 1.
reopenable.note: RI-QST09 X6 permits at most two declared redemption paths, each with a stated price. This is one.

reopenable.price: A body brought in from the flats and burned at the player's own cost, and the topic `make amends` raised with a Court member of rank 5 or above.

x6_note: Exactly two. Everything else in `gated` is closed for the life of the save, which is what RI-QST09 X5's irreversibility index measures.
